projects.title: HyperLog — Distributed Log Aggregator
projects.description: A high-throughput distributed log streaming engine and parser in Go with persistent disk buffering, WebSocket realtime broadcasting, and sub-millisecond query latency.

projects.title: DevBoard — Collaborative Engineering Canvas
projects.description: Full-stack real-time virtual canvas and code snippet workspace for engineering teams with CRDT-based conflict resolution, granular permission trees, and room audio chat.

projects.title: CodeJudge — Microservices Sandboxed Code Runner
projects.description: Isolated remote code execution system running user-submitted untrusted C++/Python scripts inside secure Docker containers with strict CPU/memory limits and automated test suite evaluation.

projects.title: QueryCraft — Visual SQL Query Builder & Optimizer
projects.description: Interactive web-based SQL generator and query visualizer that renders relational algebra trees, explains execution plans, and benchmarks query performance.
